safety_disclaimer: ChildNutri AI is a screening and clinical decision-support prototype. It does not provide a medical diagnosis or replace assessment by a qualified healthcare professional. Clinical management should follow current applicable clinical guidelines and local protocols.

rules.description: Emergency triage for bilateral pitting edema (Kwashiorkor hallmark)

output.action_advisory: Urgent clinical evaluation/referral recommended. Inpatient medical stabilization should follow current WHO/national clinical guidelines under medical officer supervision.

rules.source: WHO Guideline: Updates on the management of severe acute malnutrition in infants and children (2013)

rules.description: Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) emergency triage by MUAC with medical complications or failed appetite
rules.condition: muac < 11.5 and (appetite_test_pass == false or medical_complications == true)

output.action_advisory: Urgent clinical evaluation/referral recommended. Child requires immediate inpatient stabilization for complicated severe acute malnutrition.

rules.source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Statement: Child growth standards and identification of severe acute malnutrition (2009)

rules.description: Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) triage by MUAC without medical complications (Uncomplicated SAM)
rules.condition: muac < 11.5 and appetite_test_pass == true and medical_complications == false

output.facility_referral: Outpatient Therapeutic Programme (OTP) / Primary Health Centre
output.action_advisory: Urgent clinical evaluation/referral recommended. Outpatient therapeutic management should follow national CMAM/IMAM guidelines under qualified supervision.

rules.source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Statement: Child growth standards and identification of severe acute malnutrition (2009)

rules.description: Severe Wasting diagnostic threshold by Weight-for-Height/Length Z-score

output.action_advisory: Urgent clinical evaluation/referral recommended. WHZ below -3 SD denotes severe wasting requiring clinical workup and therapeutic nutrition support.

rules.description: Acute growth degradation / rapid weight loss velocity

output.action_advisory: Concerning growth trajectory detected. Rapid weight loss warrants prompt clinical evaluation to rule out acute infectious illness or dehydration.

rules.source: WHO Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI)

rules.description: Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM) monitoring threshold by MUAC

output.action_advisory: Targeted supplementary nutritional support and dietary counseling recommended. Biweekly growth monitoring by frontline health worker.

rules.source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Statement on Child Malnutrition (2009)

rules.description: Moderate Wasting threshold by Weight-for-Height/Length Z-score

output.facility_referral: Primary Health Centre / Community Nutrition Center
output.action_advisory: Nutritional counseling and growth monitoring recommended. Review feeding practices and schedule clinical re-evaluation within 14 days.

rules.description: Stunting (chronic undernutrition) threshold by Height-for-Age Z-score

output.action_advisory: Linear growth deficit noted. Promote age-appropriate complementary feeding with diverse animal-source and fortified foods; monitor growth monthly.
Weight deficit relative to age. Review feeding frequency, calorie density, and recent illness history; schedule follow-up within 14 days.
Weight trajectory is flat across consecutive evaluations. Early growth faltering identified before acute wasting manifests; review feeding adequacy.

rules.source: WHO Guidelines on Growth Monitoring and Promotion

rules.description: Standard pediatric growth monitoring for healthy parameters
rules.condition: whz >= -2.0 and haz >= -2.0 and waz >= -2.0 and (muac == null or muac >= 12.5) and has_bilateral_edema == false

output.action_advisory: Anthropometric parameters track within normal WHO growth standards. Continue exclusive breastfeeding (0-6m) or balanced complementary feeding and routine immunizations.

rules.source: WHO Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) Guidelines
